test_title: PYST 9: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

They __plan to marrying__ in the spring.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"plan to marrying"** is** incorrect **in English grammar.
 
• The correct form is **"plan to marry,"** which uses the **base form of the verb after "to."**
 
• In English grammar, after verbs that indicate planning or intention (such as **"plan," "intend," "want")**, use the** base form of the verb **(also known as the **infinitive form**) following** "to."**
 
 
• Example: "I **plan to travel **next year."
 
 

The correct sentence is** "*They plan to marry__ in the spring.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Other options **("plans to marry," "plan to married"**) also **have grammatical errors.**
